title: Kosh Performance Report
description: Schema for the kosh performance report: load times, console messages and failed network requests across several pages of a WordPress site, at desktop and mobile viewports. Renders through the standard QA renderer in scripts/generate-report.js.

url.description: The homepage URL the test started from.

websiteName.description: Site name from og:site_name, the WordPress site title, or the page title.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the test was run.

provenance.description: What produced this report, so runs can be compared across plugin versions, skill edits, and models.

model.description: Exact model ID the skill ran as, self-reported by the model; "unknown" when its system prompt does not state one. The only provenance field the skill writes.

pluginVersion.description: kosh version from .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

skills.description: SHA-256 of each skill directory that produced the report, keyed by skill name. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

seal.description: SHA-256 over the report timestamp, pluginVersion and skills, marking the block as script-stamped for this run. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

environment.description: Environment the site was running in during the test. Defaults to production.

testMethodology.description: Short prose description of how the test was performed: pages and viewports, how timings were taken, and anything that affects how the numbers compare, such as a warm browser cache.

visitedPages.description: URLs of every page visited during the test.

mobile.description: Homepage measurements at the mobile viewport. Findings on other pages go in issues.

desktop.description: Homepage measurements at the desktop viewport. Findings on other pages go in issues.

critical.description: Site-breaking: JS errors causing a white screen, a CSS 404 breaking the layout, 5xx errors on core pages.

high.description: Significant user impact: load time over 3s, broken images, mixed content on scripts, recurring JS errors.

medium.description: Noticeable but not blocking: load time 2–3s, non-critical 404s, console warnings.

low.description: Minor: console logs that shouldn't be in production, third-party script warnings.

webUrl.description: An http(s) URL of a page kosh navigated to. URLs observed on the site, such as a failed request's, are plain strings: a malformed one is something to report, not to fix in the JSON.

viewport.description: Viewport size as WIDTHxHEIGHT, e.g. 375x812 or 1920x1080.

url.description: The page measured, normally the homepage.

loadTime.description: Page load time in milliseconds. Never 0: loadEventEnd reads 0 when taken before the load event, so re-measure instead.

type.description: Console message type as the browser reports it, e.g. error, warning, log.

console.description: Console messages logged on this page.

status.description: HTTP status; null for a request that got no response, such as blocked mixed content.

type.description: Resource type, e.g. script, stylesheet, image, font.

network.description: Failed requests only: 4xx and 5xx responses, and mixed content. Successful responses and 3xx redirects are left out.

category.description: Performance = load times exceeding targets. JavaScript = console errors from JS failures. Network = 4xx/5xx failed resource requests. MixedContent = HTTP resources on HTTPS pages. ServerError = 5xx server-side failures.

issue.description: What is wrong, naming the specific resource, page or behavior.

device.description: Which viewport the issue was observed on.

pages.description: URLs where the issue was observed.

metric.description: The measurement behind the finding, e.g. 'Load time 3.4s (target < 3s)'.

screenshots.description: Paths relative to the reports/ directory, e.g. 'screenshots/homepage-network-tab.png' for a file saved at reports/screenshots/homepage-network-tab.png.
